title: Low-degree stability of Noetherian quotient-tower completion
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $r\geq0$, and let $I=(a_1,\ldots,a_r)\subseteq A$. For $X\in D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], put
$$C_I(X)=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(X\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/I^n).$$
Derived tensor is computed by a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex]; the inverse limit is the functorial mapping fibre of $1-\mathrm{shift}$ on termwise products of a strict complex tower, representing the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit]. For any integer $b$ and any morphism $f:X\to Y$ in $D(A)$, if $H^i(f)$ is an isomorphism for every $i<b$ and is injective for $i=b$, then $H^i(C_I(f))$ is an isomorphism for every $i<b-r$ and is injective for $i=b-r$. No boundedness or finiteness assumption on the cohomology of $X,Y$ is imposed.
